review_evidence.detail: capture synchronously structuredClones the caller input before first query await. It validates nonblank eight seed identity strings, template SHA shape, ambient tenant equality, approved/denied/consumed expected status, continue/final disposition, exact content/error result shape, then freezes copied seed/result. Used scalar fields no longer alias caller-owned values across lock waits.

First query selects approval_requests with all six persisted identity predicates, FOR UPDATE, limit1. Readback rechecks all six columns plus JSON actor/digest/run/tool and continuation run/tool. Missing/invisible parent only returns transaction-local request_missing. No authority or physical session guarantee is inferred from ambient tenant.

Input whitelists approved/denied/consumed; stored status must equal expectedStatus, pending/completed refused, completedAt must be null. Any non-null decoded result OR disposition refuses the write. Actual UPDATE independently predicates SQL result IS NULL and result_disposition IS NULL, so decoded JSON null cannot replace the SQL NULL guard.

After parent lock, SELECT approval_fresh_seeds under FOR SHARE with approval/tenant/owner predicates; compares all eight stored binding fields (including run/tool/action/template/proof) and valid preparedAt Date. The ninth stored prepared_at is only a validity observation, not a sealed timestamp/provenance proof. No insert, upsert, preparation, reconstruction or seed mutation occurs. Missing seed refuses; mismatching extant seed refuses.

Single UPDATE approval_requests sets result+disposition and predicates six-field identity, expected status, result SQL NULL and disposition SQL NULL. Parent lock stays held by caller transaction. final adds status completed and completed_at=clock_timestamp() in that same UPDATE. continue leaves status/completion untouched. Zero rows is cas_miss, >1 throws; no receipt, continuation ledger, model/tool, finish call or audit fabrication.

Return names are written_in_transaction or not_written_in_transaction only. There is no committed/lost/rollback/replay classification. No catch turns DB/transport errors into lost; errors propagate. A successful RETURNING row is still not COMMIT/ACK proof. Missing or conflict outcomes say nothing about other transaction outcomes.

Module explicitly requires already-authorized tenant-bound physical transaction with per-transaction authority/catalog/FORCE RLS revalidation; outer owner must supply required atomic audit, COMMIT and ACK readback. Imported Database transaction callback type is the real types/client relation. Inspected store has no import/call to this module. Compare proves candidate adds only the two new files, without changing existing store/index/Root verifier. Type annotations alone do not attest physical session, actor authority or provenance.

Nine not-null seed columns, approval_id PK, six-column parent FK with no-action delete/update and matching parent UNIQUE. Nullable result_disposition allows continue/final and only implies result presence, preserving legacy result-without-disposition rows. SQL explicitly ENABLEs and FORCEs RLS, adds zero policies, REVOKEs ALL from openbot_app and PUBLIC, no owner GUC or writer opening. This prevents normal application access until a separately reviewed authorized design; it does not make seed SQL immutable against privileged future writers.

Read complete seed SQL allowlist/metadata tests including actual CR grant/policy mutations and CR/LF comment stripping. Read complete pg-proxy CPU tests for query order/locks, caller mutation during await, input/tenant/binding/status/result/seed refusal, CAS0/>1, update exception propagation and final DB clock/no receipt. These are definitions only; pg-proxy cast intentionally supplies no actual transaction, RLS, locks, audit, COMMIT or PG behavior. Reviewer executed none, counted no tests as passed.
